edit.description: The shared test home already owns the guard's invocation half — `run_guard` (:375) and `run_guard_from_root` (:382) — but not its input half, so every caller hand-spells the `PreToolUse` payload Claude Code delivers. Add the builder family beside them, one home for the documented payload keys (`tool_name`, `tool_input.file_path`, `.content`, `.old_string`, `.new_string`), carrying the cite at that one site: a bare `Write` naming only `file_path`, a whole-file `Write` also carrying `content` (install.rs's `write_payload` shape), and an `Edit` carrying `old_string`/`new_string` (its `edit_payload` shape). The `.claude/`-write payload two suites share as a constant (`CLAUDE_WRITE_PAYLOAD`, install.rs:1516) becomes a call, not a second constant.

23 spellings of one builder job, counted on disk: raw JSON literals at :1516, :1569, :1596, :1611, :1626, :1661, :1682, :1698, :1711, :1733, :1748, :1764, :1778, :1795, :1812, :1822, :1851, :1875 and :3271, a `payload_for` closure over `serde_json::json!` (:1908), a second inline `json!` in the dot-root case loop (:1996), and the two local builders the rest of the file ignores — `write_payload` (:2026) and `edit_payload` (:2196). Every site calls the `common` builder; the two local builders and the closure are retired (symbols, not files). The `{local_path}`/`{bound}` `format!` sites (:1748, :1812) become builder calls over the same interpolated path.

Six more spellings of the same shape: :529, :538, :560, :591, :593, :939. Four of them (:529, :538, :560, :939) omit `tool_name` entirely — the guard binds those writes by path, so the builder supplying `"Write"` must leave every verdict unchanged; confirm each, and if a payload's missing tool genuinely carries a claim, keep that one site hand-authored with the claim stated. `POST_TOOL_USE_PAYLOAD` (:874) stays as it is: a cited `PostToolUse` fixture with a `tool_response` shape nothing else carries, already one home for it.

summary: One guard-payload builder job is spelled 29 ways across two suites, while the shared test home already owns the guard invocation the payloads are fed to.

tests.asserts: every guard case builds its payload through the `common` builder and reaches the same verdict it does today — the suite's existing exit-code and stderr assertions are the regression surface
the posture, corrupt-lock and root-contract guard cases keep their verdicts with the builder supplying the payload

acceptance: `cargo test` green with no verdict changed, and `rg -n '"tool_input"' tests/it/install.rs tests/it/cli.rs` returning only `POST_TOOL_USE_PAYLOAD` — the payload's key names living at one site.
notes: Hand-authored input is right here (Claude Code is the real writer, so a fixture is the only tool) — the residue is the count, and the payload key names are a documented provider fact living as literals in 29 places (`specs/process/architecture.md`, "The provider face is data"). Serialized behind the pins fold: both rewrite `tests/it/install.rs`. `tests/it/tap.rs`'s payloads are a different verb's record shape and stay out. scoped at e32e3cad
